definitions.gloss: young leaves; fresh green leaves; new foliage
definitions.explanation: Newly sprouted leaves in spring or early summer, typically bright green and tender.

examples.japanese: {若葉|わかば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{芽吹|めぶ}いた→芽吹く：13995_mebuku⟧。
{若葉|わかば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まぶしい→まぶしい：03737_mabushii⟧。
examples.english: The green of the young leaves is dazzling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{五月|ごがつ}→五月：00625_gogatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若葉|わかば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{彩|いろど}られる→彩る：12542_irodoru⟧。
examples.english: In May, the mountains are beautifully colored with fresh green leaves.

notes:
A compound of {若|わか}い (young) and ⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧ (leaf). A seasonal word strongly associated with late spring and early summer.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{若葉|わかば} is a ⟦{季語|きご}→季語：09561_kigo⟧ (seasonal word) for early summer in haiku. The sight of fresh green leaves is celebrated in Japanese culture as a symbol of vitality and renewal. {若葉|わかば}⟦マーク→マーク：09478_maaku⟧ is also used informally to mean a beginner's mark — the green and yellow V-shaped sticker that new drivers must display.

- {若葉|わかば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{茂|しげ}る→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧ — young leaves grow thick
- {若葉|わかば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧ — the season of fresh green leaves
- {若葉|わかば}⟦マーク→マーク：09478_maaku⟧ — beginner's mark (for new drivers)
